messages.subject: Run column useage
messages.body_plain:
Hi - I have a question about how the run column information is used in MSstats.

Do these values need to be unique?  or are the primarily used for technical replicates only in the context of a particular condition and bioreplicate pair?

I am asking because I am analyzing some phosphorylation site data that I acquired on the mass spec with technical duplicates.  I have then used MaxQuant to search the data, and would like to utilize the data from the Phospho(STY)sites.txt file for my MSstats input.  However, this file has already aggregated the phosphorylation site quantification data across my technical replicates into a single intensity value.  Is this ok?

For the MSstats input file can I just put some value, like a "1" or something in the "Run" column, or should these values been unique?

Thanks,

-Danielle

messages.subject: Re: Run column useage
messages.body_plain:
Run column is important in MSstats. Because MSstats use Condition, BioReplicate, and Run information for recognize the design of experiment and fine the right model.
So, Run information should not be '1' or any unique value.

I'm not 100% sure about your experiments with technical and how phopho_site output merge. If you can provide your design of experiment part, like annotation file for original case and how it change for phospho_site data, I can give you some suggestion.

Hope to help.

- Meena

I am looking into some older result files (from version 3.3.4), and have a questions about the column SE. My understanding was that this represents the standard error of the effect size (the log2FC). However, when i sorted the table, the SE is the same for every protein across all the comparisons made (say i had ten comparisons in my matrix, i get ten different log2FC, but the same SE for each). I m not sure whether i mis-understand something or whether it was a bug. Maybe you could clarify ? either way, could you also suggest the clearest way to describe it ina figure legend ?

thanks, Ariel

messages.subject: Re: Standard error - clarification
messages.body_plain:
Error term is calculated by protein. If there are the same number of replicate per condition, SE is the same by protein.

Hope to help.
- Meena
messages.body_snippet:

messages.subject: Re: MSstats deviation group/sample quantification and groupcomparison
messages.subject_clean: MSstats deviation group/sample quantification and groupcomparison
messages.body_plain:
log2FC is the difference of mean values between conditions. So, I can't say whether log2FC=3 or not based on sample x=10, sample y=10. (no information about condition and other values of samples in those conditions.)
sample/group quantification table is summarization across replicates per sample. So, I also can't say whether it is correct or ,only with these two values.

To track the values, I need more information about that specific protein (x$ProcessedData, x$RunlevelData, output of groupComparisons, sample quantification).
If the data is confidential, please send me privately.

Hope to help.
- Meena
